subject: expression: Fixing Expression Rewrite Bug in Predicate Push Down for NULLIF with Type Mismatch (#58588)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its first parent. Core change is `WrapWithCastAsInt(ctx, expr, targetType)` to control `UnsignedFlag` propagation when implicitly casting non-int expressions to int, plus updates in control-function casting paths (`newBaseBuiltinFuncWithFieldTypes`, `TryPushCastIntoControlFunctionForHybridType`) and a small BETWEEN int-case adjustment. Checked planner NULLIF rewrite (`NULLIF(a,b)` -> `IF(a=b,NULL,a)`), comparison semantics (unsigned-aware `CompareInt`), and cast/type-flag propagation relevant to predicate pushdown for mixed types. No remaining Blocker/High issues found. Later history on `upstream/master` retains the main approach; the only notable follow-up in the same area is an added safety clone for enum correlated columns before mutating `EnumSetAsIntFlag`, not a rollback of this commit’s logic.
